{{Top|leg}}
The '''Chevram''' was the ruling [[council]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cadomai Prime/Legends|Cadomai Prime]], as part of the world's participatory democracy. A new Chevram was elected every twelve [[Standard year/Legends|years]], with a new executive officer, chosen purely on artistic skill, being appointed every year.
